violations.description: The workflow uses pull_request_target with contents: write permissions and checks out the untrusted PR head commit. This allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code from the PR in the context of the repository's secrets (DEPLOY_TOKEN is exposed to the script).
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request instead of pull_request_target, or avoid checking out untrusted code when using pull_request_target. Remove write permissions if not strictly necessary.
